adapter_rerun.reason: The V8 execution precondition requires a completed licensed signed owner algebra and independent CONFORMANT review; V4 supplies neither.

decision_rule: Every group is conjunctive. Structural analogues contribute zero unless the exact required custodian/delegation, R7 coverage/exhaustiveness, schema subfields, and applicable target-algebra rights all pass.

exact_nondelegation_upper_bound.proof: For every group, sufficiency implies its named-custodian/delegation conjunct. The conjunct is false in all twelve rows; therefore every sufficiency indicator is zero and their sum is zero.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: R7 vocabulary owner must sign closed_world=true for the exact seven-target algebra.
field_decisions.reason: No captured source asserts that the seven R7 targets are exhaustive.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: R7 vocabulary owner must ratify exhaustive, overlap-resolved coordinates.
field_decisions.reason: Standards define their own editorial/status objects, not exhaustive R7 scientific-process coordinates.
field_decisions.required_source: owner-approved target algebra retaining or superseding the public anchor

field_decisions.next_discriminator: R7 vocabulary owner must assign the exact coordinate or NONE per target.
field_decisions.reason: Public standards supply strong postpublication coordinate analogues but none assigns one exact coordinate or NONE to every R7 target.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner must enumerate exhaustive licensed operations for every target.
field_decisions.reason: Recommendations and publisher policies are not the exhaustive licensed R7 operation sets.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner must enumerate exhaustive forbidden operations for every target.
field_decisions.reason: COPE supplies retraction contraindications, but not the exhaustive forbidden V8 operation complement for seven R7 targets.
source_native_structural_analogues: COPE: when retraction is not appropriate

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner must retain decision/probe separation and sign EXPLICIT_TABLE or NONE.
field_decisions.reason: The sources distinguish notices, status metadata, relations, policies and editorial actions, but contain no owner-approved R7 probe/decision bridge table or explicit NONE.
field_decisions.required_source: owner-approved explicit bridge table or explicit NONE

field_decisions.next_discriminator: R7 vocabulary owner and host-authority owner must jointly bind per-target recommendation authority.
field_decisions.reason: COPE advises editors/publishers and Crossref records publisher policy; neither grants R7 target recommendation authority.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Host-authority owner must assign NONE, EXTERNAL_OWNER_ONLY, or SYSTEM per target.
field_decisions.reason: Editorial standards locate action with editors/publishers; they do not bind the P1 host or grant SYSTEM execution.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner must bind all five fail-closed terminals.
field_decisions.reason: COPE gives an inconclusive-evidence boundary, but no source defines all five R7 non-success terminals.
source_native_structural_analogues: COPE: inconclusive evidence can lead to expression-of-concern consideration

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Target-algebra rights holder must publish the exact completed algebra and exact applicable licence-text hash.
field_decisions.reason: Document reuse rights are heterogeneous and apply to the documents, not a completed R7 target algebra.
field_decisions.required_source: licence text controlled by the applicable rights holder

field_decisions.next_discriminator: R7 owner or delegated custodian must sign the completed algebra with identity, delegation, digest, key and timestamp.
field_decisions.reason: Institutional publication and local response hashing are not a content-addressed signature by the R7 owner over a completed algebra.
field_decisions.required_source: content-addressed signature bundle over the completed algebra

field_decisions.next_discriminator: An independent reviewer with no algebra authorship or case-outcome custody must issue a content-addressed CONFORMANT review.
field_decisions.reason: Consensus standards and cross-institution agreement are not independent semantic review of an authored R7 algebra.
